original_query: The F2C initiative to create a meeting ground for nature-friendly consumers and farmers links farmers to whom?

confirmed.answer_text: Sahaja Aharam is an F2C initiative that creates a meeting ground for nature-friendly consumers and farmers.; It builds a new supply chain on a Farmer to Consumer (F2C) model which links farmers to consumers.; The model helps farmers by increasing their income and provides consumers with access to healthy and diverse food.
confirmed.summary: The page describes Sahaja Aharam as an F2C initiative that connects nature-friendly consumers and farmers through a new supply chain model, aiming to increase farmers' income and provide consumers with healthy, diverse food via direct retailing and fair trade practices.
key_facts: Sahaja Aharam is an F2C initiative that creates a meeting ground for nature-friendly consumers and farmers.
It builds a new supply chain on a Farmer to Consumer (F2C) model which links farmers to consumers.
The model helps farmers by increasing their income and provides consumers with access to healthy and diverse food.
